title: love-ly caramelized french ground beef tagine
description: a kid-friendly french dish featuring ground beef and a rich, caramelized sauce, all in a traditional clay tagine vessel. serves 4-6 people
instructions: heat the oil in the clay tagine over medium heat, then add the onion and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
add the garlic, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
add the tomato paste, beef broth, apple cider vinegar, honey, thyme, cinnamon, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
stir in the almond milk and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
serve the tagine hot, garnished with parsley and cilantro, and topped with a pat of unsalted butter.
